parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- `zh-CN`: Chinese

- `en-US`: English

parameters.name: DynamicSql
parameters.description: Specifies whether the SQL statement is a dynamic SQL.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query SQL execution plans.
The time must be in UTC and in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: PlanUnionHash
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the execution plan.

parameters.name: ReturnBriefInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return brief information about the execution plan.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query SQL execution plans.

The time must be in UTC and in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format.
